items.prompt:
Paired SAT passages are written by:
A) two different authors on one topic
B) the same author twice
C) no one
items.answer: A) two different authors on one topic

solution.answer: A) two different authors on one topic

items.prompt:
To answer these questions, you first identify each author's:
A) position
B) handwriting
C) age

Two authors on one topic may agree, disagree, or:
A) qualify each other
B) rhyme
C) do nothing

Text 1: homework improves learning. Text 2: homework mostly causes stress with little benefit. Text 2's author would most likely:
A) disagree, arguing the benefit is overstated
B) fully agree with Text 1
C) change the topic
items.answer: A) disagree, arguing the benefit is overstated

solution.answer: A) disagree, arguing the benefit is overstated

items.prompt:
Text 1: social media connects people. Text 2: but it can also isolate them. Text 2 mainly:
A) qualifies/complicates Text 1
B) fully rejects Text 1
C) repeats Text 1

steps: Adds a caveat. Key is A.

items.prompt:
To compare two authors' views, you should:
A) match each view to its author and see how they relate
B) blend them into one
C) ignore one author
items.answer: A) match each view to its author and see how they relate

steps: Keep them straight. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) match each view to its author and see how they relate

items.prompt:
Text 1 claims wind power is the cheapest new energy. Text 2 agrees it is cheap to run but notes the high upfront cost of building turbines. Text 2's author would most likely tell Text 1's author that the claim is:
A) partly right, but it overlooks the upfront construction cost
B) completely wrong
C) irrelevant
items.answer: A) partly right, but it overlooks the upfront construction cost

steps: Agrees in part, qualifies. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) partly right, but it overlooks the upfront construction cost

items.prompt:
Text 1 argues strict leash laws protect wildlife. Text 2 argues such laws punish responsible owners. How do the authors relate?
A) They disagree about whether the laws' benefits outweigh their costs
B) They fully agree
C) They discuss unrelated topics
items.answer: A) They disagree about whether the laws' benefits outweigh their costs

steps: Opposed on the trade-off. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) They disagree about whether the laws' benefits outweigh their costs
